mainEntity.name: What tasks can I do myself versus hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIY-friendly tasks include painting and minor demolition. Structural work, electrical, plumbing, and complex carpentry should be handled by licensed professionals to ensure safety and compliance.
